summary: The First Den is a cozy forest world centered on the Spawn clearing and lakeside home, with authored roads reaching Lumenvale and Hearthmere. One live main place combines generated terrain and vegetation with authored buildings, wildlife, road actors, home interactions, and now daily den folk plus scheduled sky-dragon flights; shared managers and procedural builders provide most moving life and reusable geometry.
places: places/main - sole live place; forest-terrain generator, spawn/gravity, site and road marks, and seeded forest decoration
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - Spawn/home clearing, cob-house and garden, local fauna, Rikki/Campton, road-traveller and sky-dragon managers; pasture-site is currently a blueprint marker
places/main/cells/ - 56 authored cells of roads, bridges, roadside dressing, Lumenvale/Hearthmere districts and fauna; objects.scene holds 44 placed rows
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer entry/default main place, player and camera templates, lighting, arrival and UI
templates/player.js#player - composed player movement, gait, home interaction and delete-mode behaviors
places/main/config.yaml - forest terrain, spawn/gravity, site/path marks and procedural decoration bindings
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#cob-house - active procedural cob-house at (0, 0.5, -26), cellar through roof deck
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#fauna-ground + #fauna-small - local large-fauna and small-critter managers
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#road-travellers + #sky-dragons - route actors and scheduled overhead flights
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#square-door - authored door assembly and square transition behavior
shared: scripts/forest-terrain.js - configured main heightAt/materialAt contract for terrain and terrain-relative placements
scripts/gen/forest-plant.js + scripts/gen/valley-mesh.js - shared seeded forest vegetation builders across decoration layers
scripts/lib/road-solid.js - shared solid geometry for road bridges and roadside dressing
scripts/lib/home-interaction.js + scripts/lib/data/home-feel.js - player press targeting and home-interaction tuning
scripts/lib/data/player.yml + scripts/lib/data/ropes.js + camera tuning data - movement/flight/rope and view behavior settings
scripts/lib/data/fauna-ground.json + scripts/lib/data/fauna-small.js - large/small fauna species and animation tuning
scripts/lib/data/travellers.json + anim/traveller.yml - road roster/routes/kinds and traveler animation clips
scripts/lib/data/dragon.js - dragon spine/trail dimensions shared by jade-dragon geometry and sky-dragon motion
notableExports: scripts/forest-terrain.js - GROUND, SITES, LAKE, heightAt(ctx), materialAt(ctx)
scripts/fauna-ground.js + scripts/fauna-small.js - scheduled updates for tagged fauna families
scripts/road-travellers.js - updateSchedule, update(ctx) for dynamic road actors
scripts/sky-dragons.js - updateSchedule, onSpawn(ctx), launch(ctx), roar(ctx), update(ctx), launch event ear
scripts/gen/jade-dragon.js - radiusAt(z), centreY(z), skeleton(), weightsAt(z), geometry(ctx), collider(ctx); scripts/gen/pasture-fence.js - geometry(ctx), collider(ctx)
ownership: places/main/config.yaml + scripts/forest-terrain.js - terrain seed, material/site marks, forest scatter, derived ground height/material
places/main/cells/*.scene - authored row IDs, positions, tags and initial state for fixed buildings, roads and actors
scripts/player.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - movement intent, velocity, jump, flight and rope behavior; scratch timing in ctx.session, shared flight/cam toggles on player state
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/camera.js - player yaw/gait channels; camera view/eye and local-player visibility
scripts/fauna-ground.js / scripts/fauna-small.js - behavior and animation for their tagged animal populations
scripts/road-travellers.js - dynamic traveler rows, route progress, placement, animation/audio and scheduling; roster values in travellers.json
scripts/sky-dragons.js - manager sequence/timers/live IDs and spawned sky-dragon path state; sky-dragons.yml owns flight, color, sound and timing parameters
scripts/den-folk.js - NPC phase, plans, tasks and dialogue cursor in each Rikki/Campton state; den-folk.js data supplies individual routines and lines
flows: places/main/config.yaml terrain generator + seed -> scripts/forest-terrain.js heightAt/materialAt(ctx) -> engine terrain, river channels and forest material bands
places/main/config.yaml site/path marks + decorations -> terrain clear/grade/material features and seeded forest vegetation builders
road marks in places/main/config.yaml -> route corridors; authored cells add bridges, dressing, signs and rest features toward Lumenvale/Hearthmere
move/look/jump/camView input -> scripts/player.js -> movement, jump, flight and camMode; place gravity applies to player body
movement near rope coordinates -> scripts/player.js + lib/data/ropes.js -> climb/slide velocity and deck step-in
move/look input -> scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js -> yaw/gait; player body + camMode -> scripts/camera.js -> view and local visibility
interact input -> scripts/home-player-feel.js + lib/home-interaction.js -> nearest aligned press; fauna pet press writes petAt/petBy for fauna-ground response
tagged fauna rows + manager -> fauna-ground/fauna-small -> movement, follow/pet behavior and species clips from anim/*.yml
road-travellers row + road marks + travellers.json -> scripts/road-travellers.js -> route-positioned walker/rider/caravan rows, animation and audio

sky-dragons manager timer or sky-dragons:launch event -> scripts/sky-dragons.js -> 1–3 scripted jade-dragon geometry rows, looping spine wave, trail and flight path; expires rows and schedules next flight
press on den-folk NPC -> scripts/den-folk.js dialogue damageNumber; update cycles sit → findPath walk → chore animation → home, with humanoid-locomotion handling gait
square-door approach/passage triggers -> scripts/square-door.js -> portal link/door transition; authored frame and sign rows assemble it
behaviorFamilies: places/main/config.yaml decoration layers + scripts/gen/forest-plant.js / valley-mesh.js - seeded plants, trees, shrubs, ferns and reeds varied by layer, kind and terrain binding
scripts/gen/cob-house.js - authored procedural hexagonal multi-level house geometry/collider with cellar, spiral stair and roof deck
scripts/gen/road-bridge.js + scripts/lib/road-solid.js - reusable bridge geometry/collider varied by dimensions and seed
scripts/gen/road-dressing.js + scripts/lib/road-solid.js - roadside lamps, milestones, rest furnishings and sign arms varied by kind/direction/length
scripts/gen/animal-{bear,deer,fox,wolf}.js + scripts/fauna-ground.js - large animals share manager behavior, varied by species, individual state and appearance
scripts/gen/critter-{bird,duck,rabbit,squirrel}.js + scripts/fauna-small.js - shared small-critter manager with species-specific geometry and animation
scripts/road-travellers.js + scripts/gen/traveller-{walker,rider,caravan}.js - route-driven travelers share manager/animation, varied by kind, route, roster and speed
scripts/sky-dragons.js + scripts/gen/jade-dragon.js - manager-spawned long dragons share procedural spine mesh and wave flight, varied by palette, scale, route and flight tuning
probableOrphans: scripts/flat-terrain.js - no current place config selects it; main uses forest-terrain
scripts/jade-dragon.js - no scene row attaches this actor behavior; sky flights use scripts/gen/jade-dragon.js geometry directly
scripts/gen/pasture-fence.js + scripts/lib/data/pasture.yml - rescue-pasture builder/tuning have no active scene or code consumer; x0z0 currently has only pasture-site blueprint marker
migrationNotes: forest-terrain.js heightAt/materialAt take a context object; main's river is at sea level y=0, ground is around y=0.5, and the Spawn clearing is centered near (0,-3).
Keep places/main/config.yaml material IDs and decoration bindings coordinated; terrain marks include home/settlement clearings and cobble/gravel/yard road corridors.
The active cob-house placement (0, 0.5, -26) must stay aligned with homeSite/homeClear terrain marks; local levels and openings are defined by HOUSE/holesFor in cob-house.js.
Road marks and authored bridge/dressing cells are coordinated over long routes; bridge origins are at road level y=0.5 and bridge length runs along local Z.
scripts/player.js keeps high-frequency movement, flight and rope scratch in ctx.session; player.state.flying/camMode are shared toggles, and flyTapWindow is milliseconds.

The sky-dragon manager uses scripts/gen/jade-dragon.js as dynamic primitive geometry, not the separate scripts/jade-dragon.js actor behavior; pasture-site is still a blueprint marker, not an assembled pasture.
